desc:
Dr. Robert Lustig, UCSF Division of Pediatric Endocrinology, updates his very popular video  “Sugar: The Bitter Truth.” He argues that sugar and processed foods are driving the obesity epidemic, which in turn affects our endocrine system. [10/2013] [Show ID: 25641]

recs.stt: Obesity and Overweight Prevalence for the U.S
recs.x:
Sugar seems to be a major driver of this development. The main problem is likely excessive sugar and especially fructose consumption starting with the emerge of cheap HFCS in most products. Dr. Robert Lustig has put a lot of research into the causes of the obesity crisis. He goes into great detail in his lectures on YouTube [link] 
He also argues against the "gluttony and sloth" prejudice by saying that you eat too much and move to little as a consequence of messed up hormones due to excessive fat. Not the other way around.
